nodes.text:
You'll want to know why a smith is a priest. Everyone does.

Because here the fire is the congregation and I'm the one who talks to it. Blades second. But yes - blades.

I negotiate with it. Worship implies it's listening for my sake.

Every edge I've drawn out here came from a forge I had to relight, feed, and talk down. Slag Titans were poured in furnaces like mine. I try to make things that cut them instead.
